spec_case: issue #674: runtime.adapters.<name>.stream: false restores the old request
description: `runtime.adapters.ollama.stream: false` sends the pre-streaming request body (`"stream": false`, no NDJSON parsing) and produces no `progress` event, even though ollama streams by default. Python only: electricity does not read `runtime.adapters.<name>.stream` at all (issue #676, electricity streaming parity).
